text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
While walking through the academy grounds, 
I spotted a black-furred cat.

text_block_list.name: Cat
text_block_list.text: Nya!! Nya!! Nyaaah!! Nyaaaaaaaaa~~~~n!!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: A few hours earlier—

text_block_list.name: Karston Light O
text_block_list.text:
(Something is strange today. Many things 
are strange.)

text_block_list.name: Karston Light O
text_block_list.text:
(The surrounding colors feel overly faint, 
my line of sight seems lower, and on top 
of that—)

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
縺ゅｉ縲∝庄諢帙＞迪ｫ縺｡繧ｓ縲 
縺薙ｓ縺ｪ縺ｨ縺薙ｍ縺ｧ縺ｩ縺＠縺溘？

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text: 縺願？縺檎ｩｺ縺？ 縺昴ｌ縺ｨ繧る♭縺ｳ縺溘＞？

text_block_list.name: Karston Light O
text_block_list.text:
(............ I cannot understand a single 
word.)

text_block_list.name: Karston Light O
text_block_list.text:
Did you eat something strange, Durandal? 
Rotten eggs or sour milk, perhaps?

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
菴輔°鬟溘∋繧九ｂ縺ｮ縲 
謖√▲縺ｦ縺阪∪縺励ｇ縺？

text_block_list.name: Karston Light O
text_block_list.text:
(No good, nothing is getting through at 
all. Durandal is a lost cause. I shall 
leave her be.)

text_block_list.name: Karston Light O
text_block_list.text: (...Hm? Is that Believe this time?)

text_block_list.name: Karston Light O
text_block_list.text:
Hey, Believe. Durandal was acting strange. 
Do you know anything about—

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
...窶ｦ窶ｦ迪ｫ縺 
縺ｩ縺＠縺ｦ縺薙％縺ｫ窶ｦ窶ｦ縲……?

text_block_list.name: Karston Light O
text_block_list.text:
(—Ah, so Believe is a lost cause too. What 
a calamity.)

text_block_list.name: Karston Light O
text_block_list.text:
(Everyone has gone mad. I am the only sane 
one left. —What should I do?)
Nya~n, nya-nya~~n♪

text_block_list.name: Karston Light O
text_block_list.text: —! A cute kitty!

Nya~n♪ That's right, I'm a kitty♪ ! Light 
O-chan!

text_block_list.name: Karston Light O
text_block_list.text: IT SPOOOOOKE!!!

text_block_list.name: Cat
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, I startled you, didn't I? But don't 
worry. After all, we're fellow cats now. 
Let's get along♪

text_block_list.name: Karston Light O
text_block_list.text: Fellow cats? What do you mean by—

text_block_list.name: Karston Light O
text_block_list.text:
Hah, my body has become a kitty too! So 
fluffy and plush...!

text_block_list.name: Karston Light O
text_block_list.text:
Why? I do not understand, but I am 
thrilled! I am thrilled to have become a 
kitty! Nyan!

text_block_list.name: Cat
text_block_list.text:
Nyan, nya~n♪ I'm so happy to have another 
friend♪ Let's stay together forever from 
now on, Light O-chan♪

text_block_list.name: Karston Light O
text_block_list.text:
Nya!! Nya!! Nyaaa!! Let's stay together 
forever from now on, kitty!

text_block_list.name: Godolphin Barb
text_block_list.text:
—So here you were, Grimalkin. And Light 
O-chan too.

text_block_list.name: Karston Light O
text_block_list.text: —Huh. Wait, you're not a kitty?

text_block_list.name: Karston Light O
text_block_list.text:
And you are Godolphin Barb-san. Which 
means this place is... VR space?

text_block_list.name: Godolphin Barb
text_block_list.text:
Yes. It seems you were trying to train 
here, Light O-chan.

text_block_list.name: Godolphin Barb
text_block_list.text:
However, that little one—my pet 
cat—tampered with the settings, turning 
your avatar and sensory information into 
that of a cat.

text_block_list.name: Godolphin Barb
text_block_list.text:
But it's alright now. I have restored the 
settings back to Horse Girl. You're 
completely back to your normal self, Light 
O-chan.

text_block_list.name: Karston Light O
text_block_list.text:
Back to a Horse Girl... Wait, does that 
mean I can't talk to kitty anymore...?!

text_block_list.name: Cat
text_block_list.text: Nya.

text_block_list.name: Karston Light O
text_block_list.text: Guh, no way...! Kitty-chaaaan....

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
I came here for our promised training 
session, and to think... you had turned 
into a cat.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
The scheduled time has long since passed. 
I would like to begin, are you ready?

text_block_list.name: Karston Light O
text_block_list.text:
Neko-neko... nyan-nyan... Ah, my dream 
kitty life...

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: ...It seems she is not ready.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
*sigh* Honestly, really... I am constantly 
at your mercy...
